interpretation_contract: Clause matches are conditional textual classifications, not life-event truth, a complete doctrine, or a net risk score. Unknown premise remains unknown. Competing/supporting/damaging/rescue clauses are retained simultaneously.

bazi.school: Explicit bounded month-command rule extraction from Gengcunji/Ziping Zhenquan text; distinguish month-command yongshen from a modern optimal balancing element.
bazi.strength: Report season/main hidden element, roots in hidden stems, heavy-root phases (yang longlife/prosperity/peak, yin prosperity/peak), supportive visible stems. Do NOT infer complete strength from weighted tally or season alone. Full strong/weak dependent clauses abstain unless only their structural premise is reported.
bazi.pattern_selection: Pure cardinal branches 子午卯酉 use main hidden stem; other branches use a sole exposed month-hidden stem when unique, main hidden stem if none exposed, ambiguous if multiple. Visible stems exclude the day stem. If a complete trine including month is present, ordinary selection is flagged transformation-dependent. Peer/month-blade patterns require separate selection of finance/officer/output candidates; do not invent a unique yongshen.
clauses: BZC01 officer with wealth/resource and no observed damage: formation structural premises
BZC02 officer with hurting-officer: damage; exposed resource: rescue candidate
BZC03 wealth with rob-wealth and output/officer: rescue candidate
BZC04 eating-god with indirect-resource: damage; wealth: protective candidate
BZC05 seven-killings with eating-god: control candidate; resource: adverse interaction; wealth plus resource: rescue candidate
BZC06 hurting-officer with officer, excluding metal-day water-output exception: damage; resource/wealth rescue contexts
BZC07 yang-blade month: officer/killings containment versus absence; wealth/resource and no hurting-officer formation context
BZC08 peer-command month: officer+wealth/resource or wealth+output or killings+eating-god structural formation premises
bazi.combination_rescue: For each natal month clash record available six-harmony or complete-trine third-party counterweights. Multiple competing combinations are unresolved, never automatically remove clash. Stem combinations preserve positions and whether they involve the day master; not all combinations are treated as removal.
limits: No unique yongshen when candidates compete
No exhaustive classical hierarchy or climate adjustment

ZWC02 decadal fallen major + malefic/Ji together with yearly and minor-cycle malefic contexts: adverse conjunction premises; natal longevity-star rescue is recorded separately

ziwei.focus: yearly/decadal primary focus remains life and health only; interpretation uses stated original natal-life and dynamic-life contexts and identifies each explicitly
ziwei.brightness: Use pinned iztro tables; temple/prosperous=庙/旺, fallen=陷; missing brightness is unknown, never favorable by default
limits: Terms such as many beneficial stars lack unique thresholds and remain contextual
